_comment: Obstacles AUTHORED against the painting, merged into the derived geometry by scripts/derive_town_walkable.py. This exists because a handful of large props cannot be derived: the well's rim is real cobble -- the same stone, the same colour, with open cobble all around it -- so no colour, texture or local-density test separates it from the square, and tightening the derivation to catch it only buys well coverage by eroding open ground. That is the same reason walkable-regions-v1.json says the overworld's own curves were 'fitted once to visible walkable ground' with the mask as evidence only. Coordinates are ART pixels on portSapphire-screen-v5-graded.png (1885x1885, 29 art px/cell); the script converts to world pixels.

obstacles.why: Measured radially from the well's centre: paving coverage runs 0% at r=0, 33% at r=9, 17% at r=18, 36% at r=27, 49% at r=33 and only reaches 72% at r=39. The structure therefore ends at about r=36. Owner flagged it twice; the derivation reached 74% coverage and stalled on the lit rim.

exemptions.why: OWNER 2026-08-03: 'the mast of the ship should not block the player's path.' The moored trader's mast rises from the deck BELOW the quay and its upper section and yard-arm cross over the walkable paving. The derivation is structural -- it reads a top-down painting, where height is not encoded -- so the overlap read as a solid object at ground level. The player walks under it.

OWNER 2026-08-03: the rope-wrapped glass demijohn dangling from the cargo davit east of the warehouse, on its chain. Same reason as the mast: it hangs in the air over open quay. Covers both derived fragments -- the chain link above and the vessel below.

_exemptionComment: Regions where a DERIVED obstacle must be dropped because the object is OVERHEAD, not on the ground. The derivation reads a top-down painting and cannot infer height, so anything that is not paving becomes solid -- including masts, hanging signs and suspended props the player walks beneath. These are authored for the same reason the well is authored: no local test on the image can recover the missing dimension. Coordinates are ART pixels on portSapphire-screen-v5-graded.png (1885x1885, 29 art px/cell).
